criterion: Dead ends / one way per task
description: Creating a task 'under' a vein-filtered board does not put it in the vein: the New task form has no Vein field and does not inherit the active Vein filter. The only fix is a CLI operation that needs the task ID and vein ID, which the browser does not show.
expected: New task preselects the active vein (with a Vein field to change it), or detail offers 'Add to vein'.
actual: Form fields: Title, Description, Status, Priority, Assignee, Tags. The created task has no vein and disappears from the filtered board.
suggested_fix: Add a Vein select to the New task form defaulting to the active vein filter; add a vein add/remove control in task detail.

description: After creating a task that the active filters hide, closing the panel shows no notice; focus falls back to New task and the task seems to vanish.
expected: A notice such as 'Created "…" — hidden by the current Vein filter. Show all' after close.
actual: Board unchanged; only 'Saved locally · synced' in the live region.
suggested_fix: When the selected or just-created task is excluded by filters, show a dismissible notice with a one-click 'Clear filters'.

description: Two vein-filter entry points behave differently: the Goals vein title resets Assigned to and Status to All; the nav Vein select keeps them.
expected: Both entry points produce the same filter state, or the reset is visible.
actual: Status 'Review' reset via Goals; Status 'In progress' kept via the nav select.
suggested_fix: Make the Goals entry only set Vein (or make both reset), consistently.

description: The view nav (Tasks/Goals/Activity/Control) sits at y≈132 on Tasks but y≈107 on Goals because the filter row is absent, so the tabs jump ~25 px when switching views.
expected: View tabs keep a fixed position across views.
actual: Nav shifts vertically between views (compare screenshots/step-0.png and screenshots/step-2.png).
suggested_fix: Give the nav row a fixed min-height or align it to the top regardless of filters.
